title: EEAMS Summer Workshop 2026

WORKSHOP I – Live Patching A hands-on workshop exploring the fundamentals of live patching and real-time sound generation and control using Max.
WORKSHOP II – Sound Synthesis A hands-on workshop exploring sound synthesis techniques in Max, from designing sounds to applying them in electronic music creation.
